chosen.rule: Lowest p99 latency among configurations reaching recall_at_top_k >= 0.95; null when none does.

diagnostics_note: Added after the sweep. ivf_list_sizes come from rebuilding each IVF index with the sweep's builder on the same vectors; FAISS k-means runs with its fixed default seed.
memory_definition: peak_rss_growth_during_load_macos: rise in peak resident memory while a fresh process loads the index file. rss_growth_after_load_linux: rise in current resident memory across the load. A peak includes transient load-time buffers, so for IVF-PQ in particular the macOS figure may overstate steady-state memory.
query_definition: user-tower vectors (recency-weighted mean pool) of servable users
recall_definition: recall_at_top_k and recall_at_10: fraction of exact top-k (top-10) ids recovered, against brute-force inner-product search over the trained item vectors. tie_aware_recall_at_10: a returned top-10 item is a hit if its exact score is at least the exact 10th-best score minus 0.001.
